summary: Residential kerb near a junction; homes 13 m away on the same side.

best_section.where: south kerb of Ward Street, just west of the junction and bus-zone signs

drivers.seclusion: Detached house and bungalow 13 m from the kerb on the same side; homes all round, apartments opposite.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerbside parking lane; a car is parked here, room for a van before the junction.
drivers.traffic: Quiet street, but the end of the stretch meets a busier cross road.
drivers.convention: Cars park along both kerbs; bus zone signs apply on school days 3:10-3:30pm.

flags: Max grade 5% near the junction end
sun_shade: Mostly open; small trees on the south verge shade it a little from the west.
